tagline: Specialty pharmaceutical and CDMO services leader in Europe
hero_kpi_rationale: The CDMO displays solid growth (+5%) and represents an increasing share of revenue, with strong operational execution, positioning ROVI on a higher value-added and more recurring segment.

kpis.name: CDMO segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from manufacturing and development of medicines for other companies.
kpis.description: The CDMO segment reached 37.4 M€ in Q1 2026, up 5%, supported by sustained demand and reinforced vertical integration.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue remaining after deduction of production costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin stands at 62.3% in Q1 2026, up 3.8 percentage points year-over-year, driven by better cost absorption and favorable product mix.

kpis.name: EBITDA margin
kpis.explanation: EBITDA divided by revenue, a measure of operational profitability.
kpis.description: EBITDA margin stands at 13.3% in Q1 2026 versus 13.2% a year earlier (20.3 M€ EBITDA / 152.5 M€ revenue), impacted by decline in bemiparin sales and pricing pressure.

kpis.name: Operating revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by the company's core business activities.
kpis.description: Operating revenue stands at 152.5 M€ in Q1 2026, down 2%, affected by decline in heparin-linked medicine sales.

kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on fixed assets to maintain or expand operations.
kpis.description: Capex amounted to 7.7 M€ in Q1 2026, down 7%, in a context of rationalization ahead of the acquisition of the US site.
kpis.signal: Temporary reduction before Phoenix site integration

kpis.name: Net profit
kpis.explanation: Profit after all charges and taxes.
kpis.description: Net profit dropped to 9.4 M€ in Q1 2026, halved compared to the prior year, due to decline in sales and EBITDA margin.
kpis.signal: Sharp decline due to margin pressure

kpis.name: EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization.
kpis.description: EBITDA stands at 20.3 M€ in Q1 2026, down 33% in absolute value, reflecting negative impact from decline in heparin sales.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 0.83 bn€ last year

kpis.name: Enoxaparin sales
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of enoxaparin, an anticoagulant medicine.
kpis.description: Enoxaparin sales grew 2% to 41.2 M€ in Q1 2026, driven by higher volumes from international partners.

kpis.name: Bemiparin sales
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the sale of bemiparin, another anticoagulant in the heparin family.
kpis.description: Bemiparin sales fell 35% to 17.7 M€, due to overstocking with international partners and increased competitive pressure.
kpis.signal: Sharp decline driven by partner overstocking

kpis.name: Okedi sales
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of Okedi, a flagship injectable risperidone product.
kpis.description: Okedi sales showed 37% growth to 17.2 M€ in Q1 2026, reflecting increasing adoption of this schizophrenia injectable product.
kpis.signal: Strong growth supported by rising adoption

kpis.name: Neparvis sales
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of Neparvis, a specialty portfolio product.
kpis.description: Neparvis sales reached 14.2 M€ in Q1 2026, up 4%, demonstrating stability of the specialty pharmaceutical portfolio.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in the provided documents. ROVI does not appear to position AI as a current strategic lever.
evidence: No reference to AI in execution or product development
Absence of AI-related KPIs or initiatives
Focus on manufacturing, vertical integration and biosimilars
